006package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008/**
009 * Represents the distinct phases of the validation pipeline.
010 * <p>
011 * Used by {@link ValidationEventListener} to report phase-level timing events.
012 */
013public enum ValidationPhase {
014  /** Schema validation against XML or JSON schema. */
015  SCHEMA_VALIDATION,
016  /** Constraint evaluation against Metaschema constraints. */
017  CONSTRAINT_VALIDATION,
018  /** Post-validation finalization, including cross-document constraints. */
019  FINALIZATION
020}
